headline: Bitcoin is holding just above $80,000 on a quiet Saturday after two days of ETF withdrawals, with the Fed's rate decision due on Wednesday.

market.asOf: Read from CoinGecko coin pages at about 11:55 UTC (18:55 Bangkok) on Sat 24 Oct. The 24h changes are CoinGecko's headline figures; its stats tables showed slightly different numbers. Fear & Greed is Alternative.me's daily value for 24 Oct. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 51, Neutral (Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index, 24 Oct)

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose money for a second straight day
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs, funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors, saw another $137.9 million leave on Friday 23 Oct after a $635.6 million outflow on Thursday. Strong buying earlier in the week means the week as a whole still ended slightly positive.
points: Friday's net outflow was $137.9M, led by BlackRock's IBIT (-$110.3M) and Fidelity's FBTC (-$31.8M), per Farside Investors.
Thursday's $635.6M outflow was the largest daily outflow since June, per The Block. IBIT lost $254.1M, FBTC $217.5M and Ark's ARKB $109.4M that day, per Farside Investors.
Before Thursday the week had inflows of $526.7M on Monday, $23.2M on Tuesday and $524.8M on Wednesday, per Farside Investors.
Farside's five daily figures add up to about +$301M for the week.

sources.label: The Block: Bitcoin ETFs swing back to net outflows

stories.title: Bitcoin hovers near $80,500, just under its 50-day average, ahead of the Fed
stories.summary: Bitcoin has slipped under its 50-day moving average, a widely watched trend line. Oil at its highest since March keeps worries about inflation and higher interest rates alive before Wednesday's Fed decision.
points: CoinGecko showed bitcoin at about $80,543, down 1.4% in 24 hours, when read at about 11:55 UTC on Saturday.

Cointelegraph sees support between $80,000 and $81,500, around what ETF buyers paid on average, and an analyst it quotes warns of a possible retest of $78,000-$80,000 if bitcoin cannot climb back above the average.
Brent crude is around $116, its highest since March, per Cointelegraph.
The Fed decides on Wed 28 Oct at 2:00pm ET with rates at 3.75-4.00%, per FedRateCalc; 94 of 100 economists in a Reuters poll expect a hold, per PrimeXBT.

sources.label: Cointelegraph: Bitcoin seeks support above $81K as Brent hits highest since March
PrimeXBT: Reuters poll, Fed to hold in October

stories.title: Phantom wallet starts offering Kalshi prediction markets to US users
stories.summary: Phantom, a popular self-custody crypto wallet, began rolling out Kalshi's regulated event contracts to US users on Friday. Users must verify their identity with Kalshi, and some categories are blocked in certain states.
points: Access is rolling out gradually over the coming weeks; trades are funded with Phantom's CASH stablecoin, per The Block.
The fee is $0.02 per contract plus a network fee, per The Block.
Kalshi has handled more than $291B of volume this year, per The Block.
Sports contracts are blocked in Michigan; Nevada and Washington also block elections, politics and entertainment, per The Block.

Robinhood says bitcoin, oil and gold contracts are among its fastest-growing prediction products, with crypto contracts as short as 15 minutes; CoinDesk notes such short contracts can produce rapid losses.
